entities.summary: Laureano López Rodó was a Spanish lawyer, professor, diplomat and politician who served as Commissioner (1962–1965) and Minister for Development Planning (1965–1973) during the rule of Francisco Franco. Later he was Minister of Foreign Affairs (1973–1974).
